tools.name: search_lanes
tools.description: Search paid x402 APIs (lanes) by keyword: TOLLA booths first, then the public x402 Bazaar index. Returns URL, price in USD, networks, paying wallets and calls over 30 days, and whether TOLLA Pass can pay it (Robinhood Chain only). Leave query empty for the most-paid lanes.

tools.name: x402_market_scan
tools.description: Numbers for the 500 most active x402 APIs in the public Bazaar index: total listings, paid calls and payer/API pairs over 30 days, median price, how many lanes are concentrated (few wallets, many calls each) and lanes per network.

tools.name: lane_report_host
tools.description: Free check of one host against the public x402 Bazaar index: its listings with price, networks, paying wallets and calls over 30 days. Pass a host (api.example.com) or a full URL.

tools.name: list_booths
tools.description: Every open TOLLA booth: name, what it returns, price in USDG, method, payee and the URL to call (x402 or MPP on Robinhood Chain). Booths run by TOLLA say so.

tools.name: get_receipt
tools.description: One TOLLA toll receipt by id (24 hex characters): booth, payer and payee, amount in USDG, the API's status code, settlement transaction and explorer link. Status not_charged means nothing settled.

tools.name: network_stats
tools.description: TOLLA's own counts: open booths, settled and not-charged tolls, paying wallets. Team activity (wallets TOLLA lists) is kept apart from outside activity; always report the two separately.

tools.name: network_status
tools.description: Live health of TOLLA: the API, the booth gateway, both x402 facilitators, the Robinhood Chain RPC and the x402 index, checked every 5 minutes, with 24 h and 7 day uptime.

tools.name: lookup_agent
tools.description: Look up AI agents in the ERC-8004 identity registry on Robinhood Chain by agent id, owner address or name.
